newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lockheed repeated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lockheed repeated as buy.

text.p: -- Lehman analyst Joseph Campbell said he reiterated a buy rating on Lockheed Martin Corp.
-- cited company winning contract for Space Based Infrared System, "the biggest military space competition of the decade," over rival Hughes Electronics Corp.
-- sees award as "visible proof of the technical, financial and marketing clout" of company.
-- last Friday, Lockheed's Missiles and Space division received a $1.59 billion U.S. defense contract for development of a satellite system to detect missile launches, the Air Force said.
-- The contract is for development and delivery of five geosynchronous satellites with infra-red detection capability and a ground system as well as two special payloads, the Air Force said.
-- Lockheed shares rose 2-1/4 to 90-7/8, while Hughes shares added 1/4 to 55-5/8 in midmorning exchange trading.
